investigations.title: High pipeline latency on oi-tds-prd-eus2p-01
investigations.query: Investigate high pipeline latency on oi-tds-prd-eus2p-01 for the past 6 hours
thoughts: Analyzing the pipeline latency metrics for stamp oi-tds-prd-eus2p-01. The P95 latency spiked to 12.5s at 14:30 UTC — 5x above the normal baseline. Correlating with queue depth and node health.

input.query: EventTelemetry | where Stamp == 'oi-tds-prd-eus2p-01' | where TimeGenerated > ago(6h) | where Name == 'PipelineLatencyMs' | summarize p50=percentile(Value, 50), p95=percentile(Value, 95), p99=percentile(Value, 99) by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m)

investigations.title: Pipeline latency analysis — oi-tds-prd-eus2p-02
thoughts: Investigation complete. The elevated pipeline latency was caused by conservative queue polling intervals in the GDS and Streaming stages, accounting for 76% of end-to-end latency.
investigations.finalReport:
# Pipeline Latency Analysis

## Root Cause
GDS Queue Wait (1,886ms) and Streaming Queue Wait (1,590ms) account for 76% of end-to-end latency due to conservative polling intervals.
